verdict.rationale: A government online company-incorporation service could publish a machine-readable spec for a machine channel, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only the citizen-facing web workflow: authentication, pact generation, payment and notifications. Nothing in it mentions an API, an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas or a data dictionary.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
